title: Mike Wiring Netlist
description: Structured circuit the vision extractor MUST emit (never SVG coordinates). A deterministic renderer turns this into a clean SVG; the verify gate round-trips a redraw netlist against this source. Every nets[].endpoints[] {component,terminal} MUST resolve to a declared component + terminal. This separation (structure, not drawing) is the whole accuracy story.

circuit_type.description: Which single circuit this netlist describes (one circuit per netlist for legibility).

components.description: Every physical part in the circuit. id is unique within the netlist.

label.description: Human label drawn on the box, e.g. 'Contactor'.

kind.description: Optional component class (drives icon/box styling, purely cosmetic).

terminals.description: Every terminal, each owned by exactly one component. A terminal is referenced by nets via {component,terminal}. Terminal ids are unique WITHIN their component.

component.description: Owning component id (must exist in components[]).

nets.description: Each net is one electrical node connecting >=2 terminals. This is what the verify gate compares set-wise.

plain.description: One short PLAIN-ENGLISH sentence a brand-new apprentice (or a homeowner) can read — what this wire actually does, NO abbreviations. Spell everything out: HERM -> 'compressor run terminal', OFM -> 'outdoor fan motor', LPS -> 'low-pressure safety switch', 24V -> '24-volt control power'. E.g. 'Carries the 24-volt call that energizes the contactor coil to start the compressor.'

voltage_class.description: Drives color-coding + safety emphasis. line = 208/240V, low = 24V control, start = start-winding/run-cap.

wire_color.description: The real conductor color from the OEM diagram, e.g. 'yellow','black','red'. Renderer prefers voltage_class for stroke, shows wire_color as a chip.

endpoints.description: The terminals this net ties together. >=2, each must resolve to a declared component+terminal.

terminal.description: terminal id owned by that component (must exist).

notes.description: Free-text field notes (e.g. 'Factory R-Rc jumper present'). Never load-bearing for the render geometry.

source_ref.description: Provenance of the source diagram this was traced from.
